Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
To get started, make sure you have a firm, flat base—a box spring isn’t required. Slatted bases should have gaps no wider than 3 inches, and it’s best not to place the mattress directly on the floor. A mattress protector is optional, but we recommend one to help guard against spills and dirt; liquid damage isn’t covered by the warranty.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
For the Verse, unbox it as soon as you can, place it on a firm, flat base, then let it fully expand—it’s ready to use once expanded, and airing it out is optional. A slight natural-material scent may fade over a few days.
